raw.title: Philippine–American War
raw.extract: The Philippine–American War, known alternatively as the Philippine Insurrection, Filipino–American War, or Tagalog Insurgency, was a conflict from 1898 to 1902 between the United States and the Philippine Republic after the Spanish–American War. The United States ultimately prevailed, and maintained control of the Philippines until independence in 1946, other than a period of Japanese occupation between 1941 and 1945.
